# highlight.js vendor

Maki vendors the official highlight.js `11.12.0` common browser build so code
highlighting does not require a runtime CDN request or Node.js installation.

- Source: <https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release/blob/11.12.0/build/highlight.min.js>
- Upstream revision recorded by the bundle: `f7f7d3803b`
- `highlight.min.js` SHA-256: `8ab71eb09c51f501e5e25157d9cff100e46cc29bcbfc744d0b746d451fca7f53`
- License: BSD-3-Clause, reproduced in `LICENSE`

The minified file is an immutable upstream artifact. Do not format or edit it
by hand. Maki-specific language support and UI behavior live in
`assets/maki-code-blocks.js`.
